critical_code_review_comments: Resend webhook: bounced/failed error message truncation is fine, but consider capping providerEvents JSON length beyond just 20 entries — currently no per-entry size limit.

Shopify route: no 'no_line_items' short-circuit for orders/paid without line_items would abort before creating customer — currently customer is created before line-items check, leaving orphan customer records on aborted requests. Consider moving the empty-lines check earlier or wrapping in a transaction.
WooCommerce route has the same orphan-customer risk as Shopify.
